program.name: Twisting Power
program.subject: Power yoga
program.blurb: Strong flows with deep twists one day, lunges and warriors the next.
program.about: Power yoga with a theme each day. One practice drives through twisting chairs, revolved lunges and revolved triangles; the other through crescent lunges, warriors and humble warrior. Both open with sun salutations and close with core and a rest. They alternate. Level II brings harder poses and Level III holds them longer.
program.split: Twisting power flow / lunge & warrior power flow
